name: org_graph_units
description: List the Org Graph's live units in tree order, the order the Units page shows them: each with its id, name, level, parent, the provider that holds it ("espalia" or an HRIS), its head count (distinct people in it and every unit beneath it) and the person ids of its own members. Also returns the taxonomy levels, top first, and the ids of active people in no live unit. Admins only while the Org Graph is unfinished.
